direction_of_increasing_phase: theta increases along the circadian cycle in cos(theta - phi_g); prior locs place e.g. Per2 at 3.665 rad ~ 14.0 h, Nfil3 at 5.498 rad ~ 21.0 h
ZT_interpretation: a cell with posterior phase theta_h is inferred to be at circadian time theta_h under the Tempo aorta prior convention (same convention under which our frozen Tempo reproduction achieved raw sample median AE 1.18 h)
prior_source: Tempo official aorta acrophase prior asset (hash in ACROPHASE_PRIOR_FREEZE.json)
likelihood_phase_term: A_g * cos(theta_i - phi_g), theta in radians over [0, 2*pi) mapped to 48 bins of 0.5 h
